title: Cycloastragenol reduces inflammation and apoptosis in acute lung injury by inhibiting the NF-kappaB p65 and Akt pathways.
authors: Cheng, Huixian; Xu, Qixiang; Zhang, Cuifeng; Cao, Liangbin; Yao, Fen; Chen, Lihui; Guo, Min; Chen, Sixu; Wang, Jiayin; Wang, Xiaodong; Li, Qian; Chen, Yongquan; Duan, Manlin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究环黄芪醇通过NF-kB和Akt通路减轻急性肺损伤，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白作用而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cycloastragenol, a triterpenoid saponin extracted from Astragalus membranaceus, exerts several pharmacological effects. However, its mechanism of action in acute lung injury treatment remains unclear. This study was conducted to test the hypothesis that cycloastragenol can inhibit lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced acute lung injury and investigate the underlying molecular mechanisms. This study systematically explored the effects and mechanism of action of cycloastragenol in LPS-induced acute lung injury treatment using network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and experimental validation. Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Gene and Genomes enrichment analyses indicated that the effects of cycloastragenol are mediated by inflammation- and apoptosis-related genes. Both in vitro and in vivo experiments were conducted to assess the effectiveness of cycloastragenol in acute lung injury treatment. Lung function was evaluated using a pulmonary function test system with indicators, such as peak expiratory flow, minute ventilation, and lung resistance. The expression of inflammatory factors and apoptosis-related proteins was evaluated using Western blot analysis, quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, and immunofluorescence. Apoptosis in lung tissue and mouse primary peritoneal macrophages was assessed using terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick-end labelling staining and flow cytometry, respectively. Cycloastragenol effectively alleviated pulmonary dysfunction and edema, mitigated histopathological damage, and suppressed the activation of both the NF-kappaB p65 and Akt signaling pathways induced by LPS, ultimately leading to reduced inflammation and apoptosis. The results suggest that cycloastragenol alleviates acute lung injury by exerting anti-inflammatory and anti-apoptotic effects. These findings suggest that cycloastragenol could be a potential therapeutic candidate for preventing and treating ALI.
abstract_zh: 环黄芪醇是从黄芪中提取的一种三萜皂苷，具有多种药理作用。然而，其在急性肺损伤治疗中的作用机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在验证环黄芪醇能够抑制脂多糖（LPS）诱导的急性肺损伤的假设，并探讨其潜在的分子机制。本研究通过网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟及实验验证，系统探讨了环黄芪醇在LPS诱导的急性肺损伤治疗中的作用及机制。基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书富集分析表明，环黄芪醇的作用由炎症和凋亡相关基因介导。本研究进行了体外和体内实验，以评估环黄芪醇在急性肺损伤治疗中的有效性。肺功能通过肺功能测试系统评估，指标包括峰值呼气流速、分钟通气量和肺阻力。炎症因子和凋亡相关蛋白的表达通过Western blot分析、定量实时聚合酶链反应和免疫荧光进行评估。肺组织和小鼠原代腹膜巨噬细胞中的凋亡分别通过末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶dUTP缺口末端标记染色和流式细胞术评估。环黄芪醇有效缓解了肺功能障碍和水肿，减轻了组织病理学损伤，并抑制了LPS诱导的NF-kappaB p65和Akt信号通路的激活，最终导致炎症和凋亡减少。结果表明，环黄芪醇通过发挥抗炎和抗凋亡作用减轻急性肺损伤。这些发现提示环黄芪醇可能成为预防和治疗ALI的潜在治疗候选药物。
